Solving equality in the cone inequality yields x=x0±c(t0-t), exactly the caption. Horizontal sections in higher dimensions are closed balls of radius c(t0-t); no spacetime metric, numerical scale, or propagation claim is inferred from the drawing.

Theorem Statement and proof step 1.1 assume equality of u,v and their time derivatives at t=0 on the OPEN ball B_ct0(x0), and f=g on the entire closed cone. The base-data labels sit beneath the axis and the caption explicitly excludes an added endpoint hypothesis. Interior f=g labels its assumed region; u=v denotes the conclusion established by step 2.1 using finite propagation for w=u-v.
